blocks.tamil_translation: they will be presented. Allah Ta'ala will say about the scrolls of some, “Accept them,” and about the scrolls of some others, “Throw them away.” The angels will say, “By Your Honour and Majesty! We have not seen anything but good in these scrolls.” Allah Ta'ala will say, “Those deeds were not done for Me. Today I will accept only the deeds done for My pleasure,” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said. In another narration it has come that the angels will say, “By Your Honour! We wrote only what he did” (all those deeds were indeed good), and Allah Ta'ala will reply, “O angels! You have spoken the truth! (But) his deeds were done for a purpose other than My pleasure.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ اَنَّهُ قَالَ: وَاَمَّا الْمُهْلِكَاتُ: فَشُحٌّ مُطَاعٌ، وَهَوًي مُتَّبَعٌ، وَاِعْجَابُ الْمَرْءِ بِنَفْسِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو طرف من الحديث) رواه البزار واللفظ له والبيهقي وغيرهما وهو مروي عن جماعة من الصحابة واسانيده وان كان لا يسلم شييء منها من مقال فهو بمجموعها حسن ان شاء الله تعالي، الترغيب:٢٨٦/١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Miserliness that is obeyed, desire that is followed, and a person considering himself excellent — these three things destroy a person,” the Prophet ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قََالَ: مِنْ اَسْوَءِ النَّاسِ مَنْزِلَةً مَنْ اَذْهَبَ آخِرَتَهُ بِدُنْيَا غَيْرِهِ.
